problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a delivery truck. The available packages are:
* Package A: volume 10 cubic meters, revenue $288
* Package B: volume 29 cubic meters, revenue $56
* Package C: volume 6 cubic meters, revenue $173
* Package D: volume 33 cubic meters, revenue $260
* Package E: volume 7 cubic meters, revenue $164
The truck has a maximum capacity of 59 cubic meters. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
